measured_mechanism: Every miss preserves the requested two-line structure and item value but corrupts the exact prompt-supplied code literal by duplicating an N/colon fragment or dropping characters from the N390 prefix. The same exact prompt literals are realized byte-identically by both passing seeds.
decision: The measured owner is seed-dependent acquisition/optimization instability in exact format-literal realization, not general English, routing, repetition, package identity, pointer execution, or shared data coverage.
authorized_next_action: Request one separate LayerCake construct for an evaluator-blind, capability-scoped exact-format prompt-span realization path. It must activate only when an unambiguous format-control instruction explicitly supplies the complete requested output literals; preserve v21 behavior otherwise; add no acquired parameters; pass CPU/CUDA identity, package, persistent-state, sparse-execution, and hostile ambiguity tests; and return a signed immutable interface before any ABI rescreen. Do not copy ABI evaluator logic into LayerCake.
claim_boundary: Read-only mechanism attribution only. No repaired host, stable B50, minimum, matched baseline, final test, Phase 4, or ABI-superiority claim.
